# Show progress while a workspace backup is being read

## What & Why
Large workspace backups are read asynchronously, but the current import control gives no immediate indication that the file is being processed. A temporary status would reassure users and make the restore flow clearer before the confirmation appears.

## Done looks like
- Selecting a workspace backup shows a non-blocking loading status while FileReader is active
- The status clears when the confirmation opens or an error is shown
- Keyboard and screen-reader users receive the same progress feedback
